instrument: Tulare County Board of Supervisors formal position on data center development
summary: Supervisors voted 3-2 to adopt a formal position opposing most data center development within county boundaries, including in areas outside the county's land-use jurisdiction.

source.citation: Strisker Data Centers Daily Notes, Sept 28, 2026 (digest)

confidence_note: Resolution not read. A position on areas outside county jurisdiction (cities) is not itself a land-use control there.
